Chapter 7 - Sequence Grabber Panel Components / Sequence Grabber Panel Components Reference

Functions

This section describes the functions that may be supported by sequence grabber panel components. It is divided into the following topics:
  • "Managing Your Panel Component" discusses the functions that allow sequence grabber components to load, configure, and unload your panel component.
  • "Processing Your Panel's Events" describes the functions that allow your component to receive and process events in your panel.
  • "Managing Your Panel's Settings" tells you about the functions that allow sequence grabber components to collect and reset your panel's settings.
